title: Preconditions v2 with ledger bounds, min sequence and an extra signed-payload signer
pattern: CAP-0021 preconditions: ledger bounds, a minimum source sequence, and an extra signer that is a signed-payload key (P…) whose signature must be on the transaction.

hazards.placement: Preconditions.PRECOND_V2 with ledgerBounds, minSeqNum and extraSigners
signed-payload key as a CAP-0021 extra signer

facts.says: The extra signer is eve's key with the 32-byte payload sha256("xdrproof:extra-signer"), a P… strkey.
Ledger bounds are min 1, max 0 (no upper bound).
The transaction carries two signatures: bob's and the signed-payload signature for the extra signer.
